trained_dt_emb.notes: Walker-only condition. 009e excluded (seed=0 duplicate of 008d). 010b excluded (Cheetah Run, reported separately in cross_env). Effective n=2: seed 0 + seed 2.

no_dt_emb.notes: 009c NVE estimated from qualitative 'normalized v/e < 1.5x'. 008f_s3 NVE peak (35K+) = 0.85 @ step 95K. exp_020 excluded — vanilla DreamerV3 (no gate/subsample), different experimental design from no_dt_emb (which has gate+subsample but dt_embed_dim=0).

vanilla_baseline.notes: Vanilla DreamerV3 (no gate, no dt_emb, no subsample). C6 control experiment — proves trained dt_emb is necessary for Pathway B collapse.

full_sgs.notes: exp_018 excluded — invalid config (gate_enabled=false, D065). Only 018v2 is valid Full-SGS. NVE 1.66× is 35K+ window peak.

cross_env_classification.false_positive_detail: exp_008e_v3_s2: NVE 3.78× but collapse is Pathway B (eval-driven entropy divergence), not CIVO

method: bootstrap 10000 resamples, percentile method; Wilson interval for binomial proportions

effect_size.note: trained_dt_emb (n=2, mean=3.085; Walker-only, 009e excluded as seed=0 duplicate, 010b excluded as Cheetah) vs no_dt_emb (n=3, mean=0.88)
